name: lightspeed-mods
description: LightSpeedWP mods: guardrails that enforce the org and project standards at the point the agent would break them.

plugins.name: secret-sentinel
plugins.description: Refuses to write a credential into a file, and refuses to author a credentials file at all. Names the kind of secret, never the value.

plugins.name: wp-guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks git commit and push, blocks reading wp-config.php whole, and adds the WP-CLI memory flag to any bare wp command.

plugins.name: verify-gate
plugins.description: Reads the output of lint, test and PHP checks, so a failure hidden behind | tail or an exit 0 cannot pass as a success.

plugins.name: org-conformance
plugins.description: A branch line above the prompt, /branch and /pr, and a template gate on gh pr create, driven by the org's own validator and PR templates in ~/.github.

plugins.name: browser-arbiter
plugins.description: Pins the session to the first browser MCP it uses, so playwright and chrome-devtools cannot fight over one profile. /browser-release unpins.

plugins.name: changelog-guard
plugins.description: Runs the org's Changelog Quality rules on entries as they are written, before CI blocks the merge. /changelog checks the branch.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Likely next prompts after each turn; /next asks them as a question for the VS Code panel. Fork of hamzafer/claude-code-mods next-steps (MIT).

plugins.name: model-policy
plugins.description: Holds every subagent spawn to one model rule table: an inherited model runs at the cap, an over-tier one is refused unless the prompt carries an Escalation line. /model-policy shows the table.
